name: HELLAS PLANITIA — the deepest floor on Mars

meta.site: Hellas Planitia — the deepest floor on Mars
meta.citation: ESA Mars Express HRSC + NASA MGS MOLA blended global DEM, 200 m/px, v2
meta.grid: azimuthal equidistant about the site, resampled bilinear, long axis on bearing 59 deg
meta.resolution_note: source product is 200 m/px; this 1024x512 grid at 4 m/px spans 20 x 10 source posts and is a 50x bilinear resampling of them — interpolation, not added detail
meta.layout: row-major, +x along the traverse, +y to its left
meta.note: Seven kilometres below datum, where the atmosphere is thickest. The floor grade is shallow but never stops.

blurb: Seven kilometres below datum, where the atmosphere is thick enough for liquid water to be briefly stable. The floor grade is shallow and never stops.
